items.quote: Prices are determined on either yearly basis or 18 months basis depending upon contract.

items.statement: Planned capex of ₹1,800 crore for optical fiber, cable, and preform manufacturing
items.quote: Our planned investment of approximately ₹1,800 crore across optical fiber, cable and preform manufacturing will expand capacities.

items.statement: LMW expects **50% revenue growth** in Machine Tool Division (MTD) for FY27 due to strong demand.
items.quote: "the aspiration there is definitely be, if you see the growth pattern as of now, I think it is closer to a 50% growth for the current year."

items.statement: Textile Machinery Division (TMD) has **₹3,400 crore** order book, with **₹2,600 crore** active.
items.quote: "we hold an order book currently of around ₹3,400 crores, of which an active order book is roughly ₹2,600 crores."

items.statement: ATC division has **₹1,000 crore** order book, with **30% composites** and **70% metallics**.
items.quote: "the order book still remains the same number; it's around 1,000-odd crores. The percentage of metallics versus composite is around 30% on composite side and 70% would still be metallics."

items.statement: Textile Machinery Division (TMD) EBITDA margins **turned positive/breakeven** in Q2 FY27 after being negative for two years.
items.quote: the last two years our EBITDA margin has been negative in this segment, while currently, if you look at the last two quarters, we are a bit positive or at breakeven

items.statement: ATC division aims for **20-23% EBITDA margin** going forward.
items.quote: we have also mentioned that we are probably looking for further margin expansion in ATC from probably what we have seen already, an improvement to 22% in the segmental numbers

items.statement: Machine Tool Division (MTD) demand driven by **auto sector (50%+), defense, EMS, and tooling** with **China+1 shift** boosting demand.
items.quote: the sectors: surprisingly, auto sector is still a predominant one, you know. It is still a little bit, I would say a little bit upwards of 50% is where we are delivering into. Rest of it, the entire sector I mean, be it Defense, be it EMS, be it tooling everything is expanding

items.statement: Textile Machinery Division (TMD) demand **subdued in yarn** but strong in **garmenting, fabric, and technical textiles** due to government policies.
items.quote: garmenting and the fabric people are doing well and government has given, I mean is looking at very positively the incentives again and it has also given us, I mean cotton pool duty exemptions between 1st of June to 31st of

items.statement: Machine Tool Division (MTD) **23-24% machining centers** and **76% turning centers**, with **5-axis machines** seeing gradual demand increase.
items.quote: "With respect to turning centers, machining centers, it's around 23% to 24% machining centers and 76% turning centers."

items.statement: Upgraded FY27 EBITDA margin guidance to 27% ±2% while reaffirming revenue target of >INR2,500 crores.
items.quote: Reflecting this confidence, we have upgraded our FY27 EBITDA margin guidance by 200 basis points to 27% plus-minus 2% while reaffirming our revenue target of more than INR2,500 crores.

items.statement: Targeting INR3,000+ crores revenue in FY28 with TPU and SCF capacity expansions.
items.quote: See, exact number I can't quote, but yes, we are targeting INR3,000 plus.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance for FY28 expected to be 28%+ (up from FY27’s 27% ±2%).
items.quote: So, definitely next year guidance we will elevate from this level for sure. So, we are talking 28, 28.5 for sure.

items.statement: INR500 crores capex spent in last 6 years; future capex plans pending board approval.
items.quote: We have already done 6 capex in last 6 years, that is amounting to roughly INR500 crores. And that all has been funded by ourselves. So, we will definitely aim in next 3 years more investment, but as of now, I can't tell unless it is approved by the board.

items.statement: TPU line (75% captive for PPF, 25% merchant sales) expected to generate INR75-100 crores revenue in FY28.
items.quote: So, the first question about 25% will lead to, in next financial, we expect INR75 crores to INR100 crores of sale, that's what we are targeting.

items.statement: New SCF capacity (H1 FY28) to add ~1,200 lakh sq.ft fungible capacity, targeting INR450-500 crores revenue.
items.quote: this new line will is able to contribute roughly INR450 crores to INR500 crores depending on the product mix

items.statement: PPF capacity expansion to add ~INR250 crores revenue at full utilization.
items.quote: And PPF can add around INR250 from the current level.

items.statement: Full utilization of TPU + SCF expansions could push revenue to INR3,500 crores.
items.quote: With this, both these 2 capex coming in, we can reach up to INR3,500

items.statement: Architectural films EBITDA margins: top products at 40%-45%, mid-tier at 30%-35%. PPF margins: 20%-25%.
items.quote: See, margin, if I talk like sun control, there are various products. When we talk of top of them, they go up to 40%, 45%. I am talking EBITDA margin. And when we go to the medium kind of product, it's 30% to 35%. PPF remains 20% to 25%.

items.statement: D2C margins expected to add 10%-15% on top of existing architectural film margins (~40%).
items.quote: See, base, we can say, we can we add around 10% to 15% on existing margins of which I already said roughly 40

items.statement: Management guided FY27 EBITDA margin improvement of 100-150 bps annually despite inflationary pressures.
items.quote: we'd like to maintain that, which would be around 100 to 150 basis points improvement in profitability year-on-year.

items.statement: Operating EBITDA grew 29% YoY with margin expansion of 130 bps to 13.1% despite 190 bps inflation absorption.
items.quote: Operating EBITDA grew 29% year-on-year with margins expanding by 130 basis points to 13.1%. This was achieved despite absorbing over 190 basis points of inflationary pressure.

items.statement: Strong consumer demand with broad-based growth across regions; value strategy driving traffic.
items.quote: guest count grew in double digits in each month of this quarter, demonstrating the strength of consumer demand and effectiveness of our brand plus value strategy.

items.statement: Regional growth converging (West/South); value strategy effective across geographies.
items.quote: growth numbers are converging... we don't give out a detailed breakup, but it's not as stark as it was before.

items.statement: Digital sales (75% of revenue) grew 60 bps YoY; app downloads at 58M (4.2M monthly active users).
items.quote: Digital channels contributed over 75% of sales during the quarter, increasing by around 60 basis points year-on-year.

items.statement: Delivery and dine-in both grew 15-17% YoY; broad-based channel growth.
items.quote: Both on-premise and off-premise channels delivered a healthy growth of 17% and 15%, respectively.

items.statement: Revised FY27 revenue growth guidance upgraded to 15-18% YoY, EBITDA margin 13.8-14.3%.
items.quote: Based on the strong half-year performance and the visibility we see across our customer portfolio, we have increased our FY27 outlook. We now expect revenue growth of 15% to 18% for FY27 and an EBITDA margin in the range of 13.8% to 14.3%.

items.statement: 3-year digital engineering contract renewal worth ~INR44.5 cr, 70% higher than prior term.
items.quote: A major highlight this quarter was the renewal of a 3-year digital engineering engagement valued at approximately INR44.5 crores with a global construction and mining equipment leader. The contract value increased by over 70% compared to the previous term.

items.statement: Participating in multiple large RFPs with existing customers.
items.quote: as we speak, we are participating in bid s for several large RFPs with our existing customers

items.statement: Strong demand in AI/data center engineering, power management, cooling systems, and industrial platforms.
items.quote: We are also seeing a lot of encouraging opportunities across the U.S. and Europe for digital engineering, AI -led transformation programs, data center infrastructure engineering and particularly in areas such as power management, cooling systems and intelligent industrial platforms

items.statement: EBITDA margin expanded to 15.6% in Q2 FY27, driven by higher utilization and offshore leverage.
items.quote: EBITDA grew 33.7% year-on-year to INR26.6 crores, with margins expanding to all-time high at 15.6%.

items.statement: Margin expansion driven by higher offshore utilization, productivity, and account mining.
items.quote: margin improvement that we are seeing is being driven by structural levers, which is higher utilization, increased offshore delivery, as I said earlier, more productivity and better account mining

items.statement: Transportation & Mobility (T&M) vertical growing, especially rail and automotive recovery.
items.quote: and mobility vertical has 2 sub verticals, automotive and rail transportation. Our rail transportation has been growing meaningfully for the last many quarters. Our automotive business last year, there was a lot of furloughs and shutdowns, especially across Europe. Now I think that has bounced

items.statement: Healthcare (HCLS) vertical poised for ramp-up with large customer wins.
items.quote: the ramp-up in HCLS vertical will be very similar to our other verticals and maybe even faster because we're starting at a very small base

items.statement: Management expects FY27 revenue to exceed INR 75 crore (core operations), with H2 driving growth due to seasonal demand and new assets deployment.
items.quote: "FY27, our current order book is at INR 78 crores, which is the executable order book. It should be above INR 75 crores for sure. In H1 itself, our revenue from operation is at INR 30 crores, and our total revenues are INR 35 crores. In H2, which is actually our season time, after the monsoon, we get a lot more contracts."

items.statement: ARR (Annualized Recurring Revenue) projected to reach INR 120 crore by FY28 Q3 due to new fleet deployment.
items.quote: "Now, when this INR 90-95 crores of the machines are also deployed, another INR 2.5 crores worth of revenue per month will be added. So, maybe if these machines are deployed in Q3, then from December month, FY27 to FY28 Q3, you'll be able to see that our ARR has gone up to even INR 120 crores."

items.statement: EBITDA margin for Q2 FY27 at 60.89%, with no explicit guidance on future margin trends but emphasis on fleet utilization and cost management.
items.quote: "Our EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 60.89%."

items.statement: Debt-to-equity ratio to be maintained under 2 for next 1.5 years, with deleveraging expected post-FY28 due to improved cash flows.
items.quote: "We try to make sure that our debt to equity is under 2, for the next one, one and a half years. But, of course, as I've said, that after 2028, when our cash flow skyrockets, then it will be much easier for us to deleverage."

items.statement: Debt preferred for CapEx funding; equity dilution considered only if debt becomes unsustainable or to accelerate growth.
items.quote: "First priority is to share in debt, of course, and that is only cheaper than equity. If that is a concern, then equity is the only option."

items.statement: India market demand robust but slowing in next quarters as GST cuts fade; tractor growth slower than other segments
items.quote: We expect a relative slowing down in market growth over the next few quarters as the effect of GST cuts diminish.

items.statement: Foundry division fully booked for next year post new American customer project ramp-up
items.quote: with this new project, we will have our foundry fully booked for next year. I mean, once the ramp-up is finished by mid of next year

items.statement: EU may impose 350K/year quota on Chinese hybrid imports, benefiting ICE component suppliers
items.quote: they will set up a quota limit of the imports of hybrid cars from China and the figure they have set is 350,000 per year

items.statement: Consolidated book growth of 28% YoY to ₹1,36,635 Cr in Q2FY27
items.quote: "Our consolidated book stands at ₹1,36,635 Cr, reflecting a YoY growth of 28%."

items.statement: Retail disbursements up 27% YoY to ₹24,027 Cr in Q2FY27
items.quote: "Quarterly Retail disbursements of ₹24,027 Cr, up 27% YoY."

items.statement: Gold loan disbursements up 229% YoY to ₹3,237 Cr in Q2FY27
items.quote: "We registered a robust quarterly disbursement of ₹3,237 Cr, representing a 229% YoY growth."

items.statement: Rural disbursements flat YoY at ₹6,356 Cr in Q2FY27 due to cautious underwriting
items.quote: "The business registered quarterly disbursements of ₹6,356 Cr, up by 1% YoY, mainly on account of improved collection efficiency and sectoral trends."

items.statement: NIMs + Fees stable at 10.48% in Q2FY27, guided to stay in 10%-10.5% range
items.quote: "Our NIMs + Fees, which is another focus area for us, stood stable at 10.48% against 10.47% in Q1FY27, well within our guided corridor of 10% to 10.5%."

items.statement: Credit cost improved to 2.46% in Q2FY27 (down 8bps from Q1FY27)
items.quote: "Credit cost has moderated to 2.46% this quarter, reflecting a further sequential improvement of 8 bps from 2.54% in Q1FY27."

items.statement: Home loan repricing to follow repo rate hikes, variable rate book of ₹25,000 Cr
items.quote: Yes, there will be -- we will wait for the market to react to the repo rate increases. And yes, over a period of time, we'll do that. I think our overall mix in terms of fixed and variable, we have matched both on the asset and liability side

items.statement: Rural demand muted due to monsoon uncertainty, cautious disbursements
items.quote: "We consciously chose to attenuate our Rural disbursement momentum and raised risk guardrails in view of the uncertain progression of the monsoons."

items.statement: Rural underwriting tightened in drought-affected districts (Karnataka, Maharashtra, AP, Telangana)
items.quote: our underwriting parameters, some of the guardrails have been strengthened in all these districts and the rural disbursements, whether it be tractors, etc. have already been tempered in this particular district

items.statement: Collection efficiency stable at 99.7%-99.8% in Rural Business Finance
items.quote: "Our collection efficiencies in Rural Business Finance remain in the corridor of 99.7% to 99.8%."

items.statement: Lakshya 2031 RoA target of 3%–3.2% remains achievable despite insurance commission risks.
items.quote: we are reasonably confident that our stated objective of Lakshya 2031, which is delivering an RoA profile of 3% to 3.2% will be met.

items.statement: Opex investments funded by efficiency savings; no major near-term capex hike expected.
items.quote: the investments being made actually are getting taken care of through the savings which are coming up on account of the efficiencies.

items.statement: Gold loans AUM to reach ₹40,000–45,000 Cr (~14–15% of total AUM) by Lakshya 2031.
items.quote: want Gold Loans AUM to hit about 14% to 15% of our overall AUM by the end of Lakshya 2031, which is Gold Loan AUM between ₹40,000 Cr to ₹45,000 Cr

items.statement: Rural demand resilient; no material impact from droughts (₹1,033 Cr exposure vs. ₹31,500 Cr book).
items.quote: drought declared areas, especially in Karnataka and Maharashtra, about ₹1,033 Cr is the total book relating to this, which is 3.3% of the total book. So really no impact

items.statement: Q4 FY27 transmission line evacuation expected by Q4 FY27, enabling 4.5-5 GW capacity commissioning.
items.quote: we are expecting this transmission line of Phase 3, the evacuations to come by the next quarter. That's where we currently look at it.

items.statement: Confident of exceeding 10 GWh battery storage capacity by FY27 end.
items.quote: we are very committed to not only commission the 10 gigawatt by the end of the year, but would be definitely able to surpass it too.

items.statement: 3.5 GWh battery storage capacity tied up under long-term contracts as of Q2 FY27.
items.quote: Currently, we have 3.5 gigawatts. Ashish Khanna: 3.5 gigawatt hour, which is already tied up

items.statement: Accelerated BESS deployment to mitigate curtailment; no capex shift from solar/wind.
items.quote: battery storage has come in this year, too, there has been an accelerated growth on that matter, and there is an opportunity to do that for the next few years, too.

items.statement: EBITDA margin of 92% in Q2 FY27 (vs. 93% in H1 FY27) due to curtailment; expected to improve post-transmission.
items.quote: resulting in a strong EBITDA margin of 92% during the quarter.

items.statement: Merchant power sales at INR 2.4/kWh (vs. INR 2.1/kWh in prior year) due to better market rates.
items.quote: on a merchant basis, last year, our number was nearer to about INR 2.1, and this year, because of the better listing, our merchant rates have come to INR 2.4.

items.statement: 25-year PPAs with AESL at INR 2.7/kWh (solar) and INR 3.93/kWh (wind), locking in higher returns vs. merchant risk.
items.quote: For us, we are removing that kind of risk that we were carrying on merchant. We want to carry only one major risk, which is execution.

items.statement: India’s peak electricity demand rising due to industrial growth, electric mobility, and data centers.
items.quote: India's peak electricity demand continues to reach new highs, reflecting rising consumption driven by industrial growth, electric mobility, data centers...

items.statement: Transmission delays at Khavda mitigated by accelerated BESS deployment; curtailment impact reduced in H2 FY27.
items.quote: the curtailment impact should not be as high as the earlier half because of the accelerated development on the batteries that we are doing.

items.statement: Revised FY27 profitability guidance: ROA 5.2%-5.8% (up from 4%-4.8%), ROE 21%-24% (up from 16%-20%).
items.quote: Basis our strong H1 FY27 financial performance, we raised our profitability guidance for FY27, ROA of 5.2% to 5.8% versus 4% to 4.8% earlier and ROE of 21% to 24% versus 16% to 20% earlier.

items.statement: AUM growth guidance retained at 20%-25% YoY, driven by Group Loan recovery and Retail Finance momentum.
items.quote: We retain our AUM growth guidance of 20% to 25%, supported by return to growth in Group Loan portfolio, coupled with continued momentum in Retail Finance.

items.statement: NIM guidance revised to 14.4%-14.7% (up from 12.8%-13.2%) due to asset quality, borrowing cost control, and capital strength.
items.quote: We expect a NIM of 14.4% to 14.7% as against 12.8% to 13.2% guided earlier, driven by healthy asset quality, strong control over borrowing costs and a higher capital position.

items.statement: Credit cost guidance maintained at 3%-4%, with Q3/Q4 expected to inch up slightly but stay within range.
items.quote: We're maintaining our credit cost guidance of 3% to 4%, and it should comfortably cover for any volatility on account of evolving drought-related conditions.

items.statement: Cost-to-income ratio expected to range 29%-30% due to controlled operating costs despite inflation.
items.quote: Cost to income may range between 29% to 30% as operating costs remain well under control, despite inflationary trends.

items.statement: Lending rate cuts of 50 bps planned for Q3 and Q4 FY27, with flexibility to adjust based on credit cost and borrowing cost evolution.
items.quote: We will do a 50-bps cut this quarter and probably 50-bps in the next quarter. The marginal cost of borrowing increase is slightly because of the mix of borrowing that we've taken right now.

items.statement: Group Loan AUM declined 2% YoY due to write-offs and graduations, expected to recover in H2 FY27.
items.quote: Our Group Loan portfolio stood at INR 23,746 Crore as of September 2026, a marginal decline of 2% from the start of FY27. This was on account of write-offs and graduation.

items.statement: Retail Finance AUM grew 23.3% of total AUM (up from 20.6% in Q1 FY27), with Secured Business Loans up 60.9% YoY.
items.quote: Retail Finance AUM grew to INR 7,200 Crore, now 23.3% of the total AUM, up from 20.6% in Q1 FY27. Within this, our secured book comprising of Secured Business Loans, Affordable Housing Loans and 2 -Wheeler Loans grew 60.9% YoY to INR 695

items.statement: 2-Wheeler Loan book crossed INR 60 Crore (up from INR 20 Crore in Q1 FY27).
items.quote: Our 2-Wheeler Loan book witnessed strong traction, having crossed INR 60 Crore compared to INR 20 Crore in Q1.

items.statement: Customer acquisition momentum expected to accelerate in H2 FY27, targeting >1 Lakh new borrowers/month (currently ~80K).
items.quote: We are hoping that Q3 and Q4, we should actually see momentum in customers. Ideally, we would like to publish more than 1 Lakh customers every month, and that's the target that we are working on.

items.statement: Drought-related risks in 6 districts of Maharashtra (central region) with borrowers seeking restructuring; no material impact elsewhere.
items.quote: We are seeing a few signs of drought-related challenges in October around certain pockets of Maharashtra, wherein the borrowers are requesting for additional time for repayment, including restructuring options.

items.statement: Credit cost may inch up in Q3/Q4 due to drought and festive season but remain within 3.5%-4% FY27 guidance.
items.quote: Right now, what we are saying is that even if we budget a certain amount of increase because of the drought situation, we don't see it go beyond our guidance in this entire year.

items.statement: Promoters in active discussions for strategic investor at HoldCo level; progress expected in next 2 quarters.
items.quote: Currently, the promoters are in active discussion for a strategic investor as the whole group. That is where it is. And we should see some progress in the next couple of quarters.

items.statement: Q3 FY27 same-store sales growth expected to be >10% to achieve double-digit full-year growth.
items.quote: Q3 will have to be higher than 10%, as you rightly said, for the first nine months to look like double-digit growth.

items.statement: Full-year FY27 same-store sales growth target is double-digit.
items.quote: our goal is to achieve double-digit for the full year.

items.statement: EBITDA margin expected to improve by ~30 bps annually due to double-digit growth vs. 6-7% cost inflation.
items.quote: our growth would be double-digit, whereas our cost inflation at the store level would be 6% to 7%, and that would probably improve our EBITDA margin by 30 bps every year.

items.statement: No further price increases planned; current inflation levels fully addressed.
items.quote: We do not see any need to take further price increases at this stage. And at this stage, there is absolutely no plan to tinker with the pricing

items.statement: No moderation in consumer demand despite El Niño/monsoon concerns; festive season strong.
items.quote: We are not seeing any moderation in terms of consumer and customer demand. As I mentioned, the festive season for this year started now, and we've experienced some part of that

items.statement: Belong & Co. (apparel pilot) shows strong early traction; conversion >50%, repeat purchases.
items.quote: our conversion of footfall into the store into purchase is north of 50%. So, it's very, very encouraging. And whilst it's just been a month, we have seen customers coming back to the store to buy more stuff

items.statement: Revenue guidance for FY27 revised upwards due to strong order inflow; no specific number given.
items.quote: "we are seeing increased order inflow from all sorts of customers in India also and abroad also and that's the reason our numbers are much more than what we were originally targeting."

items.statement: EBITDA margin of 28% in H1 FY27; expects to maintain or improve in H2 FY27 and FY28.
items.quote: "Yes, our efforts are to make it better and better or at least maintain it. That's our effort and we see there is no otherwise reason for us to worry."

items.statement: PAT margin expected to be maintained despite higher depreciation in FY27.
items.quote: "we would like to maintain our profit margins as last year."

items.statement: Order book execution expected over next 15-18 months.
items.quote: "The order book is expected to be executed over the next 15 to 18 months."

items.statement: Gross margin improved to 48.3% in H1 FY27 from 42.4% in H1 FY26 due to product mix, volume increase, price realization, and cost efficiency.
items.quote: "Product mix and operating leverage, which is a combination of volume increase of close to 40%, better price realization, and cost efficiency measures, were the main contributors to the improved gross profit margins."

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved to 28.1% in H1 FY27 from 23.3% in H1 FY26.
items.quote: "EBITDA margin improved from 23.3% to 28.1% year-on-year."

items.statement: PAT margin improved to 18.6% in H1 FY27 from 13.7% in H1 FY26.
items.quote: "PAT margins improved from 13.7% to 18.6% year-on-year."

items.statement: Import duty and freight savings of 18-20% expected from localized production; additional savings from overhead differences.
items.quote: "The cost saving, the import duty and the freight put together is today, say, 18% to 20%. That definitely goes away, plus the overhead difference."

items.statement: RIP bushings accounted for 86% of revenue by value in H1 FY27; OIP and high-current bushings contributed 14%.
items.quote: "RIP bushings accounted for 86% of the revenue, while OIP and high-current bushings contributed to 14%."

items.statement: Potential competition from new entrants in high-voltage RIP bushings market.
items.quote: "There are a couple of companies who have announced that they would also come into bushings, apart from the Hitachi and CG type of customers."

items.statement: Maintain same revenue growth run rate for FY27-FY28; Q3-Q4 typically stronger than Q1-Q2
items.quote: "to make better than this will always be a difficult. But as per our order book and our business plan, we are planning to and we have a pipeline to maintain the same run rate. But to make better than this requires a lot of extra efforts. But going forward, we keep trying to maintain the same run rate."

items.statement: Q3-Q4 FY27 expected to outperform Q1-Q2 due to historical seasonality
items.quote: "Absolutely right. Because if you see my last 3 years business plan or my last 3 years comparison of the business, we have always been a Quarter 3 and Quarter 4 is better than the Q1 and Q2."

items.statement: Margins expected to remain stable for next 1-2 quarters; exponential growth may strain margins later
items.quote: "So as of now, we see that at least for next couple of quarters, it will be manageable as we are scaling with our plan and our particularly business model."

items.statement: Order book as of September 30, 2026
items.quote: "So, as on date, the size number based on 31st, 30th September is Rs. 78 crores."

items.statement: ZeroTouch product expected to have >50-60% EBITDA margin; CapEx-heavy
items.quote: "it is a very good marginable product. More than 50%-60% plus EBITDA margin we have into the ZeroTouch because it is a completely proprietary product."

items.statement: Margins sustainable for next 1-2 quarters due to planned order book and recurring revenue
items.quote: "we have a complete planned order book and our business is on recurring mode. So we are able to manage."

items.statement: ZeroTouch revenue contribution expected to reach 20-22% of topline in next 2 years
items.quote: "our expectation in the next 2 years of line from ZeroTouch, we are expecting 20-22% revenue will be contributing by ZeroTouch."

items.statement: ZeroTouch revenue nominal in H1 FY27; significant growth expected in Q3 FY27
items.quote: "we have booked revenue... And Q3, we are expecting a good amount of revenues as our exam is already started from this month."

items.statement: International revenue expected in FY27 despite unfavorable market conditions
items.quote: "inspirationally, we are expecting this financial year revenue from the international."

items.statement: Exponential growth may temporarily strain margins
items.quote: "if it will be a very exponential growth, that time it will be sometimes for initial period might be difficult to manage certain margins."

items.statement: International market entry may initially impact margins due to marketing and expansion costs
items.quote: "when you enter into the new field, new areas, initial stage it will be a certain investment into the marketing plus expanding and certain cost is always becoming high."
